title: Backlog affected-selection-followups: suite selection for the path-loaded rpgf_guard package, affected.py line lengths

tasks.grade_reason: suite selection logic; a selection that is too narrow lets a regression through CI
tasks.objective: Backlog topic affected-selection-followups items 1 and 3. (a) tests/affected.py: a change to scripts/lib/rpgf_guard/__init__.py still selects every suite, because the package is loaded by path (scripts/lib/gitguard.py, the loader near line 47, spec_from_file_location of the package directory) and the import graph has no importer edge for __init__.py. Since plan leftovers-followups, affected.py already accepts that static loader; give the loaded package's __init__.py (and the package modules reached through `from rpgf_guard.<m> import`) an importer edge from the module that loads it, so a change there selects the suites that reach gitguard.py, not all suites. A module loaded only by a computed path stays unsure. Measure with `python3 -B tests/affected.py select-many` for scripts/lib/rpgf_guard/__init__.py and one rpgf_guard module before and after and report both. Keep hashes (suite reuse) conservative. (b) tests/affected.py has lines over 120 characters (the docstring line near 57 is 145): wrap the docstring and comment lines to 120 or less without changing behaviour. Tests in tests/affected.test.sh: a change to rpgf_guard/__init__.py selects git-guard and file-guard and not an unrelated suite (e.g. changelog). Changelog fragment changelog.d/affected-rpgf-guard.md (### Changed). CI runs on Linux: no test may depend on host tools of this Windows machine.
